name: @airness/node
description: The JS/TS gates of the Airness node layer, the analyzer configurations they read, and the pinned analyzers.
author: Herman Ciechanowiec <herman@ciechanowiec.eu>

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.package:reproducible: pnpm run build && pnpm pack --pack-destination target/repack && node scripts/package/compare-packs.ts target target/repack

coverageExclude.reason: the executable's entry point, which runs only as a process of its own; the command line it starts is measured
the ESLint configuration, which ESLint loads in a process of its own during the eslint gate, where the gate specs run it and coverage does not reach
read only by the ESLint configuration, in the process ESLint runs it in

the accessibility scans and the route walk the shipped sweep and a project's own specs call, which run only inside a Playwright worker during the e2e gate; the rules they apply are measured in their own modules
the layout measurement, whose page code runs in the browser Playwright drives during the e2e gate; the rules that judge its snapshot are measured in their own modules
the wait before a scan, which runs only in the browser page Playwright drives during the e2e gate
the Playwright assertion over a received response, which runs only inside a Playwright worker; the header baseline it applies is measured in security-headers.ts
the Playwright configuration, which Playwright loads in a process of its own during the e2e gate

the launcher of a Next.js production build and the loaders of its configuration and environment, which run only inside the Playwright run of the e2e gate against an installed Next; the output selection they apply is measured in production-output.ts
the TCP probe of the browser endpoint, which opens sockets and resolves hostnames; the decisions it feeds are measured in browser-server-policy.ts
browser measurements and trusted view scoping execute inside the real Playwright contracts; pure snapshot policies have their own measured unit suites
the shipped sweep executes inside Playwright workers against real pages; its verdict policies, queue and deadlines are measured separately
the Docker browser launcher is exercised by the browser server contracts; its ownership, arguments and capacity policies are measured in browser-run
the preload replaces Date in child processes; clock contracts exercise those processes and browser-run measures the clock policy
fixture generators and browser contract entry points run as separate processes in the integration suite, against real pages and pinned browser containers
the browser process orchestration runs only in the real browser integration contracts; its scope, precondition, clock and container policies have unit coverage

the services guard's entry point, which runs only as a detached process of its own; the decisions it makes are measured in services-guard.ts and the integration suite proves a killed wrapper's containers removed
the pinned child entry point executes in a separate process; the real wrapper contracts prove command execution, child failure and cleanup
The host and worker bootstraps install runtime guards in the runner processes; real transport contracts prove interception, while network-policy.ts measures every policy branch.

These probes execute browser visibility and real application error states through Playwright; the browser evidence contracts exercise their actual outcomes, while not-found route policy is measured in Vitest.
